brief.zh: 每一拍交出这是第几拍：第一拍是 0。
brief.en: Every tick, give out which tick this is: the first is 0.

t.zh: 要知道一位落在一帧的哪里，得会数。寄存卡记得住一个数，还缺一样把它往上加的东西。
t.en: To know where a bit falls in a frame, the board has to count. A register can hold a number; what is missing is something to add to it.

t.zh: 新元件<part-ref to="part:arith"></part-ref>：形状「加一」给出输入加 1，「相加」给出两个输入的和。
t.en: A new part, <part-ref to="part:arith"></part-ref>: its form Add one gives its input plus 1, and Add gives the sum of its two inputs.

after.zh: 读出、加一、存回去：一个绕过寄存卡的小圈，每拍转一次，就是计数。
after.en: Read, add one, keep it: a small loop through a register, once round each tick, is a count.
